import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Select relevant columns for analysis
# Education expenditure (Adjusted savings: education expenditure percentage of GNI)
education_expenditure = merged_df[[col for col in merged_df.columns if 'adjusted_savings' in col]]

# Human capital (School enrollment, primary and secondary)
primary_enrollment = merged_df[[col for col in merged_df.columns if 'primary_enrollment' in col]]
secondary_enrollment = merged_df[[col for col in merged_df.columns if 'secondary_enrollment' in col]]

# Economic output (GNI per capita and exports)
gni_per_capita = merged_df[[col for col in merged_df.columns if 'gni' in col]]
exports_growth = merged_df[[col for col in merged_df.columns if 'exports' in col]]

# Correlation analysis
correlation_matrix = education_expenditure.corrwith(gni_per_capita.mean(axis=1))
correlation_matrix_exports = education_expenditure.corrwith(exports_growth.mean(axis=1))

# Display the correlation results
correlation_matrix, correlation_matrix_exports

# Check for constant values in education expenditure and GNI per capita
constant_values_education_expenditure = education_expenditure.apply(lambda x: x.nunique() == 1)
constant_values_gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita.apply(lambda x: x.nunique() == 1)

constant_values_education_expenditure, constant_values_gni_per_capita
